elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims that the services/deliverables infringe IP (preferred: defence and indemnity, plus affiliates)
elements.evidence: 12(c) covers indemnity only, not express defence, and does not extend to Client affiliates: "TrueLink shall indemnify Client against any third-party claim that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"

elements.element: Coverage for claims arising from Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: No breach-of-law indemnity; 12(b) covers only "any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations"

elements.element: Coverage for data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: No data breach indemnity anywhere in clause 12

elements.element: Coverage for Vendor gross negligence/wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: No reference to gross negligence or wilful misconduct in clause 12

elements.element: Standard indemnity procedure (notice, control of defence, cooperation)
elements.evidence: Inserted 12(c) contains no notice, control or cooperation mechanics

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: 12(a) left untouched and remains broad: "(i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement ... (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective"

elements.element: Vendor IP indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall indemnify Client against any third-party claim that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"
"except to the extent the claim arises from modifications made by Client"
"combination of the foregoing by Client with items not supplied by TrueLink"

elements.element: Remedy: procure right to continue use
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall procure for Client the right to continue use of the affected item"
"modify it so that it is non-infringing"
"if none of the foregoing is available, refund the fees paid for the affected item"

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to a super-cap of 3x annual fees
elements.evidence: "TrueLink's total liability under this Section 12(c) shall not exceed 3x the annual fees paid by Client under this Agreement"

reasons: The inserted 12(c) completes every atomic element of the fallback: a Vendor IP infringement indemnity, the three usual exclusions (Client modifications, combinations, specifications), all four remedies (procure, modify, replace, refund) and a 3x annual fees super-cap.

The preferred level is not reached: no express defence obligation or affiliate coverage, no breach-of-law, Vendor data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct heads, no notice/control/cooperation procedure, and Client's broad 12(a) indemnity is not narrowed to Client content and Client's breach of law.

The cap is expressed as applying only to Section 12(c) rather than all Vendor indemnities, which is no worse for Customer than the fallback super-cap and therefore is not a shortfall against the locked level.
Minimality holds: a single concise new subsection was added for an absent clause, with 12(a) and 12(b) untouched and no boilerplate or new exceptions beyond the standard fallback exclusions.
Intent is preserved: no undefined terms are introduced (Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services are agreement terms) and no existing mechanic is left dangling.
